subject: Planning: infra design workshop for on-prem deployment
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@medicore.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Redwood discovery — next step to review on-prem design

Hi Connor / Raj,

Thanks again for the discovery call today — that was helpful. We covered the high-level goals for a private deployment: data residency, KMS integration, and network isolation. The internal infra and security teams want a focused workshop to validate fit and surface any blockers before we progress to procurement.

Can we schedule a 60–75 minute architecture workshop next week to walk through:
- Current network topology and peering constraints
- KMS/HSM options and key rotation model
- Expected ingress/egress patterns and audit log requirements
- Minimum HW / capacity profiles and pilot timeline

Attendees from our side will be Raj (cloud security), me (engineering lead), and two infra engineers (names below once I confirm). If you could share a short pre-work checklist and any examples of the deploy topology you usually present, that would help us prep.

Preferred windows (Pacific):
- Tue 11 May 10:00–11:15
- Wed 12 May 13:30–14:45

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Sara Lim
Head of Engineering, Medicore Health
---
Attachment: network_topology_v1.png (referenced)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@medicore.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood discovery — next step to review on-prem design

Sara — really appreciate the clear summary. Glad the discovery helped align priorities.

We can absolutely run a focused workshop that covers the bullets you listed. Proposed approach and asks:
1) Workshop length: 75 minutes (45 min presentation + 25 min Q&A + 5 min wrap)
2) Pre-work (attached): short checklist we ask customers to fill out (network ranges, expected RPS, preferred KMS vendor) — this helps us produce a tailored topology during the session
3) Attendees we recommend from our side: Laura (Solutions Engineer) to lead the architecture walkthrough, Marissa (Customer Success) to cover rollout cadence and success criteria
4) Deliverable: a one-page draft topology and a list of open items and recommended next steps

I can do either of your windows. Would you prefer Tue 11 May 10:00 PT or Wed 12 May 13:30 PT? If you confirm Tue, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the checklist we mentioned.

Attached: redwood_privdeploy_workshop_checklist.pdf (short prep checklist)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0132
---

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@medicore.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 09:13:40 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Redwood discovery — next step to review on-prem design

Connor / Laura — thanks, appreciate the checklist. Tue 11 May 10:00 PT works best for us. Please include the infra engineers (I'll confirm names by EOD).

A couple of asks ahead of the workshop:
- Can you bring examples of a reference VPC diagram with NAT/firewall placements? We need to map that to our existing transit setup.
- We will need to review SOC 2 evidence and how audit logs are surfaced to our SIEM (Splunk) — if you can point to the docs or artifacts you typically share that would speed things up.
- On KMS: we use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key; we want to confirm whether Redwood can integrate via an external key material or a proxy HSM.

Attaching a current (high level) network diagram for context.

Raj Patel
Cloud Security, Medicore Health
